brief: The content flywheel that compounds — 4 stages, every step diagrammed.

slots.title: Content Flywheel
slots.subtitle: A four-stage system that turns one idea into endless growth.
slots.check1: Build momentum with every post you publish.
slots.check2: Reduce creation time by reusing what works.
slots.check3: Turn casual viewers into loyal community members.

slots.title: How It Works
slots.subtitle: Four connected stages designed to compound your content efforts over time.
slots.check1: Each stage feeds directly into the next one.
slots.check2: Small inputs generate exponentially larger outcomes.
slots.check3: Speed increases as friction decreases each month.
slots.takeawayBody: A flywheel spins faster when you remove drag between creation and distribution.

slots.title: Start With Core
slots.subtitle: Begin with one high-value piece of cornerstone content every single week.
slots.check1: Anchor assets make repurposing effortless later on.
slots.check2: Solve one painful problem your audience faces daily.
slots.check3: Document your process instead of performing for cameras.
slots.takeawayBody: One strong long-form asset fuels an entire week of micro-content.

slots.title: Distribute Wide
slots.subtitle: Push atomized versions of your core idea across every relevant platform.
slots.check1: Native formatting respects each platform's unique audience behavior.
slots.check2: Consistent presence builds recognition faster than sporadic bursts.
slots.check3: Cross-promotion drives traffic back to your owned channels.
slots.takeawayBody: Distribution multiplies reach without multiplying your original workload.

slots.title: Engage Deeply
slots.subtitle: Turn passive impressions into active conversations that build lasting trust.
slots.check1: Reply to every meaningful comment within the first hour.
slots.check2: Ask questions that invite your audience to share stories.
slots.check3: Personal responses signal that you value their attention.
slots.takeawayBody: Engagement is the lubricant that keeps the flywheel spinning faster.

slots.title: Compound Fast
slots.subtitle: Extract new formats from proven content to maximize lifetime value.
slots.check1: Top-performing posts become templates you can systematize quickly.
slots.check2: Data reveals which angles deserve deeper exploration next.
slots.check3: Old content updated often outperforms new content created blindly.
slots.takeawayBody: Compounding turns your archive into your most valuable growth asset.

slots.title: Fuel The Flywheel
slots.subtitle: Feedback from engagement and data informs your next creation cycle.
slots.check1: Analytics show exactly where to double down next.
slots.check2: Community input becomes your endless source of new ideas.
slots.check3: Each completed loop makes the next rotation even easier.
slots.takeawayBody: The end of one cycle is simply the optimized start of another.

slots.body: Save this post and map your first four stages today. Consistency compounds.
